doctrine_settled_this_session: Fitter is DEMOTED to a rough seed, not the boss. Do NOT 'fix' VOICE/ARMA with more hardcoded cost heuristics — that is the treadmill Tyson named.
The path is GENERATE (machine, at scale) + CURATE (Tyson's ear = the only fitness function) + ITERATE fast. keeper_04 came from exactly this.

THIN bodies cause: a serial cascade of band-peaks (bp, rolls off below its peak) multiplicatively BURIES the low end; normalize_corner_peak then scales to the lone surviving spike. FIX = peaking-EQ stages (peak_eq_words: flat baseline + bumps) so bands stay balanced.

Morph TRAJECTORY = where the 4 corners sit (the runtime is a dumb bilinear word-lerp). It is NOT a runtime feature. 4 generator MOTION strategies author it: translate (comb climbs), glide (bumps cross), comb_fixed (notches locked/peaks move), anchored (low holds/top moves).
ROMs decode as STOCK, not product (bodies/rom/). 33 of 50 stable; the 17 LPF/HPF/sweep/EQ/PHA/FLG/VOW fail (poles on the unit circle).
Cross-breed in CURVE space (blend response curves) not pole space (pole-splice-by-index = lopsided/explodes).

Runtime stays TRANSPARENT: no in-player modulation, no MotionLaw ID, no pole-radius modulation, no cost-function fitter, no z-plane/radius on the surface (the magnitude curve = the sound's shape = allowed; coefficients/poles/EMU = never).
contamination_watch: Pasted AI theory (Gemini/ChatGPT) repeatedly smuggled the SAME rejected traps in new clothes: pin-Stage-N-as-a-role, runtime pole-radius modulation, an 'anatomy-aware fitter cost function', a z-plane/radius overlay, a runtime MotionLaw. ALL rejected. When a theory is pasted, DO NOT build a new mechanism — force the listen-loop instead.
